purpose: Visualization of preserved data; no solver was executed by this script.

conical-flow.transformation: Angular pressure profile reconstructed along rays and mirrored about axis. Radial scale is arbitrary.
conical-flow.configuration_status: Original run configuration and convergence not independently established. Filename does not prove flux choice.

compressible-airfoil.transformation: Piecewise-linear contours on original triangles; surface CPP from topological boundary nodes.
compressible-airfoil.configuration_status: 0.85 is the preserved source setting; original output convergence not independently established.

viscous-airfoil.transformation: Shoelace area of original polygons; no triangulation or flow-field interpolation.
viscous-airfoil.configuration_status: Reynolds 1000 and Mach 1.2 are source settings; this visualization contains no flow solution.
